_readme: Seeded practice questions. Each carries a problem_type, which is how a wrong answer
is matched against the misconceptions that could explain it.
Every item below has at least one wrong option that matches a misconception's
wrong_answer_pattern. seed.py verifies this and refuses to seed if an item has no
diagnosable wrong answer - because that item would silently produce the demo's
weakest moment: a wrong answer with no diagnosis.
correct_answer is stored but NEVER sent to a client.

items.prompt: A 2 kg block is pushed across a rough floor and moves at a constant velocity of 3 m/s. What is the net force on the block?
A force of 10 N acts at 30 degrees above the horizontal. What is its horizontal component?
Two forces act at a point: 3 N due east and 4 N due north. What is the magnitude of the resultant force?
A 5 kg block rests on a frictionless incline at 30 degrees to the horizontal. Taking g = 10 m/s^2, what is the normal force on the block?
A 1 kg ball and a 5 kg ball are released from the same height with no air resistance. Which reaches the ground first?
options: They land at the same time
items.correct_answer: They land at the same time

items.prompt: A block slides across a table. It is then turned so that a larger face is in contact with the table, with the same weight and the same materials. The kinetic friction force will:
A ball is thrown vertically upward. Ignoring air resistance, which forces act on it while it is still rising?
A book rests on a table. Which two forces form a Newton's third law action-reaction pair?
options: The weight of the book and the normal force on the book
The book pushes down on the table and the table pushes up on the book
The weight of the book and the weight of the table
The normal force and the friction force
items.correct_answer: The book pushes down on the table and the table pushes up on the book
